title: Color is Off and Sewing Problems
text:
Color is Off and Sewing Problems. I am trying to really love this quilt set but I really don't. However, I don't hate it. First, the color is more of a gray purple than a true purple which I couldn't get to photograph well at all. Second, the stitching on this quilt isn't good at all. It's bunched up in a few places and just looks to be very poor. It says that this quilt is reversible but honestly I don't see anything about this quilt being reversible because both sides are the same. The shames are fine but I never use shams so they are pretty useless to me. As far as the use of the quilt, it is great for a nice light weight quilt for chilly spring or fall nights or even just whenever you want to use it.
I'd take note of the color and quality though and make sure to check it out as soon as you receive it to make sure everything is sewn together much better than the one I have, otherwise I'd probably just stay away from this set all together.
